[`requestUrl`](requestUrl)

## requestUrl() function

Similar to `fetch()`<!-- -->, request a URL using HTTP/HTTPS, without any CORS restrictions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export function requestUrl(request: RequestUrlParam | string): RequestUrlResponsePromise;
```
